title: Reliance interest and opportunities forgone
summary: Reliance measures loss caused by changing position on the faith of an undertaking.
notes: The comparison is with the position before the induced change, including provable opportunities forgone. Reliance is both an interest relevant to remedy and a component of promissory estoppel, but those functions must be kept separate. A claimant must connect the change to the assurance. In D&G Stout, the lost opportunity to sell on favorable terms differs from hoped-for future distributorship profits. Hayes asks whether a retirement decision already made before the pension promise can count as induced reliance.
